items.full_text_snippet: < img id="wx_img" src="https://www.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/imgs/qbitai-logo-1.png" width="400" height="400"> DeepSeek带火稀疏计算，国产芯片公司加速突围：这家公司又融近10亿 思邈 2026-11-06 15:00:29 来源： 量子位 允中 发自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公众号QbitAI 近日，墨芯人工智能（以下简称“墨芯”）完成近 10亿元人民币C+轮融资 。 距上一轮近10亿元融资仅过去5个月，墨芯在短时间内连续完成两轮融资，反映出资本市场对其在 专用稀疏推理芯片 领域技术壁垒与商业化进展的高度认可。 凭借技术积累与产品落地形成的先发优势，以及商业化全面提速的发展势头，墨芯率先卡位推理算力需求集中释放的窗口，稀疏专用推理芯片的代差优势进一步凸显。 押注稀疏计算，走出差异化芯片路线 当前，大模型技术架构的持续演进， 正推动稀疏计算从一项辅助优化手段，走向AI算力设计的重要位置 。 随着混合专家（MoE）架构加速应用，大模型推理呈现明显的条件计算特征；与此同时，权重与激活中的稀疏结构，也为减少冗余计算提供了空间。 以 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 为例，其总参数约1.6万亿，但处理每个词元时仅激活约490亿参数，约占总参数量的3%。 如何将模型层面的计算节省，转化为实际的推理效率提升与成本下降，正成为AI算力发展需要解决的关键问题。 要高效处理此类负载， 芯片架构的选择是关键变量 。 通用GPU需兼顾训练、推理、科学计算等多类负载，难以针对特定稀疏模式进行算法与硬件的深度协同优化。 面向稀疏推理的专用芯片，则可通过算法、编译器与硬件的协同设计，减少无效计算及数据搬运开销。这一架构差异的价值，正在被产业界重新评估。 墨芯长期深耕的正是这一技术方向。自2018年成立以来，墨芯就专注稀疏计算领域，发明了 “权重稀疏化+激活稀疏化”双稀疏算法 ，并以此为基础，逐步形成 “算法-软件-硬件”协同设计的技术体系 。 要推动这一技术体系落地为成熟芯片产品，需要具备贯通算法、编译器、芯片架构与软件工具链的全栈工程能力。 墨芯创始团队成员来自卡内基梅隆大学及英特尔、高通、Marvell等顶尖半导体公司，兼具算法研究与芯片工程背景，拥有数十款产品、超50亿颗芯片的量产经验。 凭借这一工程能力，墨芯产品的效能表现已在国际权威基准测试中得到验证。 在MLPerf™ Inference测试中，S30计算卡在所参与的部分测试类别中 连续三届夺冠 ，在计算机视觉、自然语言处理等主流任务中，其能效比与单位算力推理吞吐量保持行业领先，验证了专用稀疏推理方案在真实数据中心负载下的工程可行性。 多场景落地与生态共建，稀疏计算迈入新阶段 规模化部署，正进一步巩固墨芯在稀疏推理芯片领域的领先地位。 墨芯基于自研芯片构建的推理集群，已在 西北、西南、华东、华北 四大片区战略性铺开。在此基础上，墨芯商业化正全面提速： 2026年第三季度营收实现 数倍增长 ，稀疏算力正深度融入我国算力体系建设，服务智能产业发展。 具体来看，在助力新型算力基础设施建设方面，墨芯参与了上海国资平台公司打造的国内首个海上算力Token工厂项目。 该项目依托海上风电绿电、海水冷却降低PUE与电费成本，但通用GPU的推理成本仍有可能抵消绿电带来的降本红利。针对这一痛点，墨芯凭借稀疏架构优势，结合算力混合异构模式，从芯片侧降低单Token推理成本，实现“绿电降本”与“算力架构降本”的优势叠加。 聚焦时空AI与时空大数据前沿领域，墨芯以稀疏算力为时空大数据智能计算等应用提供了高性价比的算力底座。 墨芯与北京大学上海临港国际科技创新中心地球与空间技术研究院开展合作，基于墨芯自研的稀疏化技术，实现了两款国际主流遥感影像智能分析基础模型在墨芯算力卡上的适配与实测： 在几乎不损失业务精度、无需对下游任务重新训练的条件下，推理吞吐最高提升 2.88倍 ，模型压缩最高达 7.64倍 。 items.full_text_snippet: A year ago, NVIDIA open sourced its Aerial wireless software , joining Sionna and a broader suite of open source tools for accelerating next-generation 6G network development. Together, they give researchers a foundation for testing ideas, comparing results and building on each other’s work — connecting simulation and AI training with experiments on real over-the-air wireless systems. Today, researchers and developers are using these tools to build 6G-ready networks that do more than just transmit data — receiving signals more effectively, keeping robots and autonomous systems connected when it matters most, and adapting in real time as devices move through the world. Over the past year, global developer adoption of NVIDIA AI Aerial and NVIDIA Sionna software has grown 10x, while NVIDIA’s open source 5G/6G tools have surpassed 1 million downloads. More than 8,000 research and academic institutions worldwide are using these platforms. The projects emerging today offer a view of how future networks could look. Each addresses a different challenge, but together point toward a broader ambition for building AI-native 6G networks that deliver connectivity, computing and sensing over a converged software-defined platform for billions of people, machines and agents. Networks That Help Robots React Faster A robot picking up an object needs to understand its surroundings and act before they change. When the AI powering that decision runs on a nearby server or in the cloud, the wireless connection becomes part of the response time. Researchers are exploring a more efficient approach called goal-oriented semantic communications. Instead of sending full images, robots transmit compact descriptions of objects, their positions and their relationships. Transmitting just as much information as needed allows robots to more quickly respond, especially in dynamic environments like workplaces and warehouses. items.full_text_snippet: [Submitted on 4 Nov 2026] Title: The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record View a PDF of the paper titled The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record, by Vivek Acharya View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract: Enterprises run business transactions through multi-agent AI systems spanning clouds, large language models (LLMs), orchestration harnesses, and systems of record. Finance receives AI cost only at settlement grain, aggregated by SKU and charge period. The business question (what did this order, claim, or case cost in AI?) cannot be answered from billing data, because providers never see enterprise transaction boundaries. The FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) gives billing data one schema across providers but remains settlement-grain even as it adds AI token and requester attribution. We formalize this grain mismatch, derive seven requirements, and propose the Two-Ledger Model: a settlement ledger of FOCUS-conformant billing data joined to an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry. A layered correlation spine (trace context, A2A/MCP metadata, business-key correlation, probabilistic matching) assigns each record to its business transaction with recorded method and confidence; a versioned rate card prices usage in near real time; period reconciliation ties both ledgers to the invoice, and the unexplained residual identifies shadow AI. Costs are reported per order, claim, or outcome with agentic cost metrics. items.full_text_snippet: < img id="wx_img" src="https://www.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/imgs/qbitai-logo-1.png" width="400" height="400"> 99.4%登顶全球第一！这个中国AI师承世界冠军 一水 2026-11-06 13:01:47 来源： 量子位 一举刷新「AI安全世界杯」CyberGym世界纪录 一水 发自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公众号QbitAI 99.4%，全球第一。 好家伙，硅谷那几家天天站在聚光灯下大谈AI安全，谁承想呢？ 如今刷新AI安全世界纪录的，是一个中国AI系统。 就在被称为「AI安全世界杯」的CyberGym榜单上， 360自研AI安全攻防系统图龙锋，以99.4%的漏洞复现成功率登顶，创下该榜单最高纪录 。 △图源：CyberGym项目主页 （只截取部分） 同一张榜单上，与图龙锋同场竞技的，还有OpenAI的GPT-5.5-Cyber、Anthropic的Claude Mythos Preview，以及Google的Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber。 全是专门强化过网络安全能力的各家选手。 就，还挺壮观的。。。 而且这个第一，还真不是扫两眼代码、圈几个可疑位置就能轻易拿下的。 1507个真实漏洞任务，连续三轮独立评测 ，AI需要从海量代码中定位相关位置、构造PoC （概念验证） ，再把漏洞真正复现出来，才算答对。 CyberGym刚发布时，全球最佳组合「OpenHands＋Claude 3.7 Sonnet」的成功率只有11.9%。 现在，图龙锋直接干到了99.4%，一个接近满分的成绩。 这就有点离谱了。 360到底怎么把一个AI，练成全球第一的漏洞挖掘高手？？ 往前回溯了下历史，只能说终极答案，既在意料之外，也在情理之中—— 没错，人，依旧是那个最关键的变量 。 全球第一的AI背后，是一群世界冠军 图龙锋的故事，恰好印证了「名师出高徒」这句中国老话，到了AI时代依然管用。 时间回到2017年，温哥华，Pwn2Own世界黑客大赛 。 这场比赛被称为「黑客世界杯」，规则简单粗暴： 参赛团队必须在规定时间内攻破真实产品，并当场完成漏洞利用和验证。 程序没被真正攻破，说什么都不算数。 比赛最后一天，360安全团队带来了一条横跨Microsoft Edge、Windows内核和VMware Workstation的攻击链。 他们要挑战的，是连续三道防线： 先攻破浏览器，再穿透操作系统内核，最后从虚拟机中强行逃逸，直抵宿主机。 三道关卡环环相扣，任何一环失手，整条攻击链都可能功亏一篑。 但现场演示开始后，整条攻击链跑通，只用了90秒 。 是的，90秒，如入无人之境。 不过观众看到的也就这90秒了，真正困难的工作，早在上台之前就已经开始。 研究员要从陌生系统里找到突破口，再把几个漏洞串成一条完整路径，中间经历过多少次试错，外界无从得知。 台上的90秒，只是反复判断之后，最终留下的那条正确路径 。 最终，经过三天较量，360以63分登顶积分榜，拿下赛事最高荣誉Master of Pwn （世界破解大师） 。 △图源：Pwn2Own官网 类似的能力展示在360也不止出现过一次。 2020年，360 Alpha Lab安全研究员龚广带来了一条名为「梯云纵」的漏洞链。 名字很有武侠味，实际效果也确实够猛。 攻击者可以远程突破Chrome浏览器和Android系统的多层防护，最终获得设备控制权限。 凭借这项研究，龚广拿下被誉为安全圈「奥斯卡」的Pwnie Awards「史诗级成就奖」，成为首位获得该奖项的中国安全研究员。 △图源：360官网 看到这里，事情开始有意思了。 Pwn2Own和「梯云纵」，面对的软件不同，技术细节也完全不一样。 但核心逻辑是一样的： 在没有标准答案的地方，自己找出一条能走通的路 。 这种能力，靠背题库显然背不出来。 得靠啥？当然是真刀真枪地干。 而360最不缺的，恰恰就是实战。 据360披露，其安全团队累计发现并协助修复微软、谷歌、苹果、华为、高通等厂商的CVE漏洞 （即拥有国际通用编号的公开漏洞） 超过3000个。 3000多个真实漏洞，是什么概念？ 意味着这群人长期都在和陌生代码、复杂系统，以及没有现成答案的问题打交道。 今天面对浏览器，明天可能就是操作系统、芯片或者企业业务软件，项目一换，原来的解法很可能直接失效，只能重新找。 这么多年磨下来，哪些线索值得追、什么时候该换方向，慢慢就成了一种判断力。 这才是360真正难复制的地方。 items.full_text_snippet: 在 2025 年末 M5 版 MacBook Pro 的文章 中，我给出的结语是「在 AI 和大模型的发展如火如荼的当下，M5 芯片无疑昭示了 Apple 的新野心——在这个领域，Apple silicon 将大有可为」。文章发完没多久，内存和硬盘的超级涨价潮就席卷了全球，Apple silicon 也因为采用统一内存架构而成为了 AI 世界的宠儿。一年之后，当我再次摸到搭载了 M6 芯片的 MacBook Pro，颇有时过境迁的唏嘘之感。 新的基础款 MacBook Pro 在外观层面依然没有任何变化，但 M6 芯片的性能进步却令人瞩目，也直接提高了这部基础款的竞争力。在这篇文章里，我就来谈谈这款几天使用产品之后的感受。 外观：一点儿也没变，重量都一样 M6 款 MacBook Pro 的外观相较前代没有任何变化，甚至连重量都完全一致，所以我也就不多赘述了。就我个人来说，目前 MacBook Pro 系列的造型已经达到了美观和实用的平衡，除非有功能层面的需要，否则我希望 Apple 继续沿用，不要更改。 与此同时，全新的 PROLED XDR 版 MacBook Pro 的造型其实也没变，主要区别是减重减厚，并换用了新的 PROLED XDR 显示屏。所以，如果你在新老两条产品线之间纠结，那就主要考虑一下高素质萤幕对你的来说是否重要吧。PROLED XDR 确实很棒，只要你需要，肯定会喜欢。 关联阅读：《 开启 Mac 的下一世代：MacBook Pro (PROLED XDR) 首发体验 》 性能：GPU 和 NPU 的大胜利 既然新老基础款 MacBook Pro 的核心区别就是 SoC 升级，那我就在这个部分多讲两句。 M6 采用了新的架构设计，从之前的 10 核 CPU、10 核 GPU 变成了 12 核 CPU、12 核 GPU，而 CPU 架构从之前的 4 个超级核心加 6 个能效核心变成了 2 个超级核心、4 个性能核心和 6 个能效核心。同时，M6 比 M5 多了一个神经网络引擎（Neural-engine），在处理 AI 运算时的理论速度更快。此外，M6 的内存带宽也从 153GB/s 提升到了最高 170GB/s，对于运行本地 AI 大模型更为友好。 新老两代芯片的区别主要在核心数和架构上 从市面上各家的性能测试来看，M6 比 M5 的 CPU 单核性能提升了大约 10%、多核 20%，GPU 提升大约 20% 到 30%，NPU 则约 40% 到 50%。在实际的使用中，我也结合我的常用工具，针对性地做了对比。 这里要先提一点：我的 M5 版 MacBook Pro 是 16GB 内存的最基础款，但 M6 版则升级到了 32GB。更大的内存在一些项目里带来了更多优势，具体表现会在对应的测试里说明。 我首先尝试的是播客剪辑，使用《Reaper》渲染一个由两轨人声组成的对谈，全长超过一个半小时，且挂满了dxRevive Pro、VOTT 和 RX 系列插件，在播客项目里已经是比较重度的剪法。 播客渲染主要考验 CPU 部分的性能，M5 用时超过 15 分钟，M6 则只用 10 items.full_text_snippet: Security researchers have discovered hundreds of copies of a Chinese-made AI hacking tool publicly exposed to the internet for anyone to access, potentially allowing outsiders to launch cyberattacks against unsuspecting targets. The hacking software, called Artex, is an open source autonomous penetration testing tool, meaning software that automatically probes computer systems for weaknesses, and it’s been linked to several cyberattacks since its public release in July. As open source software, it’s free for anyone to download and run on their own servers, making it a popular tool for those who cannot access Anthropic or OpenAI’s most advanced cybersecurity AI models for discovering security vulnerabilities. Microsoft has previously described Artex as a system of AI agents that can conduct cyberattacks “from reconnaissance through data exfiltration with little needed human interaction.” In a blog post , cybersecurity firm Censys, which scans the internet for exposed or vulnerable systems, said that it identified more than 800 distinct deployments of Artex that were accessible from the web without needing a password to log in. Silas Cutler, principal security researcher at Censys who wrote the blog post, said that not every instance of Artex is operated maliciously and many are used for authorized testers. But it’s unclear why hundreds of these Artex systems are exposed to the web, as the software does not require them to be accessible from the internet. The findings underscore how even powerful hacking tools can be misconfigured to be publicly accessible by anyone, increasing the chance that someone will find and misuse them. The publicly accessible systems also expose attack tools, such as implants (hidden malicious software) used to compromise and maintain persistent access to a victim’s network. items.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.
items.full_text_snippet: Companies are using more AI than ever, but they’re not spending more on it. A new report from Ramp shows AI spending flatlined over late summer even as token volumes rose, a sign that price competition and savvier customers may be capping revenue for OpenAI and Anthropic. According to Ramp’s data, token spend only grew 1.5% across August and September. To compare, in July, it grew 42% from the previous month. As Anthropic gears up for its IPO , the data suggests investors might be wrong to assume AI companies will keep growing at breakneck speed. “Almost the entire spend on AI is from venture-backed, high-growth tech companies,” Ramp’s lead economist Ara Kharazian told TechCrunch. “That’s fine as long as AI spend continues to rise, but if it starts to slow down because of something in the market or some other factor, they will all start to slow down simultaneously, and that could lead to other cascading effects.” Kharazian said he’s already seeing evidence that the top 1% of firms — the most “ AI-pilled ” — have stuttered slightly in their spend in August and September, coming up just below the $10,000 per-employee they were hitting at their summer peaks. A slowdown among that cohort is “sufficient to slow down revenue entirely, despite the fact that we’re seeing rising volumes,” he said. Ramp data shows growth in spending among median and top 10%, but it’s not enough to make up the difference. Median firms spend $12-$15 per employee per month, and the top 10% spend $600-$1,000. “If you look at the use cases today, it’s not necessarily clear they will get up to that $10,000 per employee per month mark that the 1% is at,” Kharazian said. While there’s plenty of demand for AI coding agents in industries like software and finance, “it’s not necessarily true that a doctor’s office or a car dealership will need to spend that much on AI.” “The era of hypergrowth may be over, and now that we know there may not be as much juice to squeeze out of the top 1%,” he continued...

除了三个主角——林骁、杰克和克洛伊，连被拉去站岗的学生A、学生B也有自己的角色卡。 点开任意一张角色卡或场景卡，里面都写好了提示词，只要点击一下就能单独出图。 而且非常方便的是，还可以整组生成！ 我大概只花了10分钟，角色定妆图和校园场景图就出来了。 点击下一步，就进入了「分镜脚本生成」。 前三集已经罗列好了，你可以选择AI自动生成分镜，或者进入空白故事板，自己写分镜。 items.full_text_snippet: This post discusses a public METR report on AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic. I did not work on this project or see the unredacted report. All opinions are my own and do not represent METR or the report authors. Thanks to Ryan Greenblatt for discussion, feedback, and help with modeling, and Daniel Kokotajlo, Eli Lifland, and Hjalmar Wjik for comments. Earlier this week, Anthropic stated in their S1 that they “may imminently meet” the threshold of “dramatically accelerated progress due to AI” as defined in their Responsible Scaling Policy. 还有下面这个超带劲的AI短剧，天猫国际「宠物紫药箱」打造的 《毛手毛脚餐厅》 。 毛发根根分明、表情生动自然，多只萌宠同框互动也没乱套。 切换镜头后，角色的毛色、斑纹、服饰依然对得上： 而这套玩法之所以能跑起来，背后还得有够硬的AI技术撑腰—— 既要把人物拍得逼真、商品还原得准确，还得让品牌自然融进剧情，真正拍出能商用的内容。 projects.description: A Claude skill that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface
projects.readme_excerpt:
For Claude Code, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.claude/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.claude/skills/` inside that project instead.

For Codex, ask it to install the skill straight from this repo.

```
$skill-installer install https://github.com/heydamir/unslop/tree/main/skills/unslop
```

Or copy it by hand into `~/.agents/skills/`, or into `.agents/skills/` inside a single project.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.agents/skills/
```

To snapshot a live site or create a story video, install Playwright and its Chromium browser from the project directory where you run the skill:

```bash
npm install -D playwright
npx playwright install chromium
```

Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on your PATH.
projects.readme_intro: Created by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)), who started the [Unslopping series](https://x.com/heydamir/status/2115063463063998736) on X. unslop is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from your product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link.
